paper_title: Endoscopic versus laparoscopic resection of gastrointestinal stromal tumors at the esophagogastric junction using propensity score matching analysis
study_design: Single-centre retrospective treatment comparison, December 2013–November 2023, with reported 1:1 nearest-neighbour propensity score matching.

limitations: ["The abstract reverses the eligible unmatched ER/LR allocation relative to the Results, Figure 1 and Table 1; no corrected allocation is supplied here.","Matched Table 1 lists 10 males and 20 females in an LR group labelled n=20.
